title: DepEd raises tuition subsidies for beneficiaries of aid program

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) on Wednesday said beneficiaries of its Educational Service Contracting (ESC) program are expected to receive bigger tuition subsidies for the school year 2027-2028 following the approval of rate adjustment. The program, implemented under DepEd’s Expanded Government Assistance to Students and Teachers in Private Education, provides tuition subsidies to eligible incoming Grade 7 students from participating private junior high schools. “Parents and our partner private schools have waited for this added assistance for a long time.
